title: AFCAT 02/2026 Result – Out
postName: Air Force Common Admission Test (AFCAT) 02/2026 – Flying Branch / Ground Duty Courses
vacancyDetails: AFCAT 02/2026 result for Flying Branch, Ground Duty Technical, Ground Duty Non-Technical and NCC Special Entry candidates
qualification: Graduation / engineering degree / as per branch-wise AFCAT 02/2026 eligibility
ageLimit: As per AFCAT 02/2026 official age criteria for flying and ground duty branches
applicationFee: ₹550 + 18% GST as per AFCAT fee structure
selectionProcess: Written Exam → AFSB Interview → Document Verification → Medical Examination
documentsRequired: Enrollment number, registration number, roll number or date of birth to check result; printout of result PDF for future use
howToApply:
1. Visit https://afcat.cdac.in
2. Open the AFCAT 02/2026 result login page
3. Enter registration/enrollment number and date of birth
4. View and download the result PDF
5. Save the PDF and keep a printout for future reference
shortDescription: Indian Air Force has released AFCAT 02/2026 Result. Candidates can download the result from the official AFCAT portal using registration or enrollment details.
content:
Indian Air Force (Bhartiya Vayu Sena) has released the AFCAT 02/2026 Result on the official website after the examination held on 08 August 2026.

Eligible candidates can now log in to the AFCAT portal using their Enrollment Number, Registration Number, or Date of Birth and download the result PDF. The result is important for all flying and ground duty entries under AFCAT 02/2026.

Applicants are advised to check all details carefully and keep a saved copy of the result for further selection stages.
